rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for the exact number 1,000,000 and can also be used loosely for an unspecified huge number.

example.english: This painting is worth a million dollars.
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 waa6 zik6 baak3 maan6 man1

rows.note: Use this when “million” means “many” or “thousands upon thousands,” rather than a literal one million.

example.english: A million people were at the venue.
example.jyutping: jin6 coeng4 jau5 sing4 cin1 soeng5 maan6 jan4
